night2_start.name: {name}
night2_start.text: *Back home, I shower and lie down in bed — and messenger notifications start pouring in. Three people, all at once.*

night2_msg_dain_specific.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_specific.text: Hey, the tteokbokki was good today!

night2_msg_seo_general.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow. Come

night2_msg_seo_specific.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific.text: Thanks for today. Got done early because of you

night2_msg_seo_specific_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific_2.text: I might draft you again next time. Brace yourself.

night2_msg_yuna_specific_2.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_specific_2.text: Play it for me again sometime.

night2_msg_dain_general.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_general.text: Yo, snack bar tomorrow! Still salty we skipped it today!

night2_msg_dain_general_merge.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_dain_general_merge.text: Roof at lunch tomorrow? Should be a nice breeze.

night2_msg_seo_general_alt.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general_alt.text: I'll leave the rooftop open tomorrow. Come if you have time

night2_msg_yuna_general.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_general.text: Are you coming to the annex tomorrow?

night2_msg_generic.name: Dain
night2_msg_generic.text: Hey! You're coming to the snack bar tomorrow, right?

night2_msg_generic_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_generic_2.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow

night2_msg_7.name: {name}
night2_msg_7.text: *Three message threads open one after another. Before I can write a reply, the battery indicator drops one bar.*

night2_reply_dain_4.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_4.text: nah wait mild tteokbokki doesn't count lol

night2_reply_dain_react_high.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_high.text: Seriously, what are you? You have to come to the gym tomorrow!

night2_reply_seo_1.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_1.text: Call me and I'll be there

night2_reply_seo_3.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_3.text: It's an easy one to keep.

night2_reply_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_4.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch. Don't be late.

night2_reply_seo_react_high.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_high.text: You're pretty interesting. Want to meet on the rooftop for lunch tomorrow?

night2_reply_seo_react_default.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_default.text: Hm. Got it. See you tomorrow.

night2_reply_yuna_3.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_3.text: *The reply box stays empty for a while. Then a new message bubble appears.*

night2_reply_yuna_4.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_4.text: That playlist from earlier. Listen to the third track too.

night2_reply_yuna_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_5.text: *I open the playlist Yuna shared again. The third track is a little faster than the one we listened to together.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_b.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_b.text: *I put in my earphones and press play. A low drumbeat comes in behind the piano.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_c.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_c.text: *The song ends, and the progress bar stops in its final segment.*

night2_reply_yuna_7.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_7.text: *Beneath the playlist title is a short note from Yuna: 'The third one is the least quiet.'*

night2_reply_yuna_react_high.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_high.text: If you listened to the whole thing, tell me what you thought tomorrow. Want to come to the annex?

night2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
night2_dain_freetalk.text: Wait, before you actually sleep. What was the most fun part of today?
night2_dain_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 2, and Dain and the transfer student are wrapping up the day over messenger. Their time together today and the messages already exchanged are established events. They are not dating yet, and this is a phone chat rather than a face-to-face meeting. Do not have Dain arrive in person or act as if they share a room.
night2_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a candid, quick-reacting volleyball player. Her energy carries through in text, but she does not pressure the other person to answer. When interested, she shows it naturally through teasing and direct questions.

night2_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
night2_seo_freetalk.text: Oh, wait. You're still awake, right?
night2_seo_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 2, and Seoyeon is continuing a messenger conversation a little longer. Today's school events and the messages already exchanged are fixed facts. They are not dating and are still getting to know each other. This is a phone chat, so do not create physical contact or actions in the same space.
night2_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is composed and has clear standards as student council president. She does not exaggerate her interest; curiosity comes through in dry jokes and honest questions. She does not control the other person's words or behave as if the relationship is already settled.

night2_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
night2_yuna_freetalk.text: Wait. If you're still awake, want to talk a little longer?
night2_yuna_freetalk.context: It is the night of Day 2, and Yuna is quietly continuing a messenger conversation. Today's memories of the annex and books, along with the messages already exchanged, have happened. They are not dating and are carefully building trust. This is a phone chat, so do not turn it into a scene where they see or touch each other in person.
night2_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is thoughtful and observant. She chooses her words before sending them, and as she grows comfortable she volunteers more of her tastes and questions. She does not treat silence as rejection and respects the other person's pace.

night2_hidden_check.name: {name}
night2_hidden_check.text: *Between the messenger alerts, I spot another notification.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *A notification appears in the school counseling system. 'Transfer student adjustment check-in complete. If you need further support, use your homeroom teacher's office hours or book a session with the school counseling center.'*

night2_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *The available counseling hours are listed beneath my homeroom teacher's name.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *I check the booking button, then dismiss the notification.*

night2_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_1.text: *A notification from the health app. 'Nurse's office record: Transfer student — elbow abrasion (minor). Keep the bandage dry until tomorrow morning. If an edge lifts or blood seeps through, have it replaced at the nurse's office.'*

night2_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_2.text: *I bend my elbow once. The corners of the bandage are still firmly in place.*

night2_end_1.name: {name}
night2_end_1.text: *I send my replies and set the phone down.*

night2_flashback_1.name: {name}
night2_flashback_1.text: *Minsu's words keep coming back. 'Seoyeon, Dain, Yuna — all three of them smile at you.'*

night2_flashback_2.name: {name}
night2_flashback_2.text: *I scroll back a long way. A field trip photo from three months ago. Sojeong smiles beside me. In each photo after that, her desk has been pushed a little farther back. The lower section where the graffiti had been is cropped out.*

night2_flashback_3.name: {name}
night2_flashback_3.text: *The notes app is full of sentences I never sent. 'Teacher, on Sojeong's desk—' 'Again today—' Every one ends on the first line. The last edit was at 2:17 a.m.*

night2_flashback_5.name: {name}
night2_flashback_5.text: *The thirty-eighth memo is the last. Beneath it, the thirty-ninth has no title at all. The next day, Sojeong's seat stayed empty until the final bell. Our homeroom teacher only said she had transferred.*

night2_flashback_7.name: {name}
night2_flashback_7.text: *I close the gallery. My finger stops over the delete button. In the end, I turn off the screen.*

night2_flashback_8.name: {name}
night2_flashback_8.text: *I pick up my phone again. Beneath the chat I just replied to, two names still wait side by side without an answer.*

night2_flashback_9.name: {name}
night2_flashback_9.text: *I open Sojeong's photo again. I'm standing next to her, looking at the camera. Sojeong is looking at me.*

night2_flashback_10.name: {name}
night2_flashback_10.text: *I open the chat I replied to, then close it. I still haven't found the words to send to the other two.*

night2_end_2.name: {name}
night2_end_2.text: *The three names stack up on my lock screen. I read every notification, turn off the display, then turn it on again.*

night2_end_2_b.name: {name}
night2_end_2_b.text: *Two unread notifications are stacked above Minsu's message.*

night2_end_3_b.name: {name}
night2_end_3_b.text: *Even after the screen goes dark, my hand stays wrapped around the phone.*

night2_end_4_b.name: {name}
night2_end_4_b.text: *I open the fridge. Leftover rice, eggs, seaweed. I take out a lunchbox and set it on the table. I haven't opened the lid yet.*

night2_end_4_c.name: {name}
night2_end_4_c.text: *I put in rice, egg, and seaweed, then close the lid. That's all the side dishes.*

forced_violation_day2_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_after_seoyeon.text: *Even after the conversation ends, Seoyeon remains silent for a while. When she finally speaks again, her voice has gone cold.* Don't think you can pretend what you just did never happened. Don't come near me or contact me for a while.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's expression does not soften at the apology.* I heard you. That doesn't erase what happened. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day2_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts the explanation short.* A misunderstanding? The moment I said no, it stopped being one. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day2_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_after_yuna.text: *After the conversation breaks off, Yuna takes a short breath. Only caution remains on her tense face.* You knew I didn't want it, and you ignored me. I don't even want to see your face right now. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_yuna_apologize.text: *Yuna answers only after a long pause.* An apology doesn't make it disappear. Stop now.

forced_violation_day2_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day2_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna refuses to hear the explanation through.* I said no. There's nothing to explain.

forced_violation_day2_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_after_dain.text: *Dain does not laugh it off the way she usually might. A long silence passes before her voice returns, short and rigid.* This isn't a joke. I said no and you forced it anyway. I'm not letting this go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_dain_apologize.text: *Dain finally gives a short answer after a long pause.* Fine. Then we're done for today. I decide if and when we talk again.

forced_violation_day2_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day2_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough.* No. Don't make excuses. I said no, and you did it anyway.

forced_violation_day2_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_after_teacher.text: *After the conversation ends, the homeroom teacher draws the line in an even firmer voice.* What you just did clearly crossed a line. Do not come any closer. I will handle this through the proper procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher takes a short breath before continuing.* I heard your apology. The proper procedures will still go ahead. Don't say anything else.

forced_violation_day2_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day2_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher cuts off the explanation.* This is not the time to start explaining yourself. Stop talking and keep your distance.

forced_violation_day2_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_after_nurse.text: *As the conversation cuts off, all the usual playfulness leaves the school nurse's voice.* Keep your distance from now on. I will document what happened and inform the people who need to know.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day2_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_nurse_apologize.text: *The school nurse is silent for a moment, then answers firmly.* I'll hear your apology. The record and notifications still stand. This conversation is over.

forced_violation_day2_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day2_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops lower.* Do you think calling it a misunderstanding changes anything? The fact is that you ignored a refusal.
